user.title: 4HEAT Lite Stove
user.description:
Enter the details from your 4HEAT WiFi module label.

Cloud sync requires a DNS override and firewall DNAT rule on your router. See [Cloud API Proxy](https://github.com/pafernanr/homeassistant-4heatlite#cloud-api-proxy) for setup instructions.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to module. Verify IP and that stove is powered on.

init.description: Cloud sync requires a DNS override and firewall DNAT rule on your router. See [Cloud API Proxy](https://github.com/pafernanr/homeassistant-4heatlite#cloud-api-proxy) for setup instructions.

schedule.title: Weekly Heating Schedule
schedule.description:
Edit the stove's weekly heating schedule. Leave empty to keep current schedule unchanged.

Format: eco/comfort/comfort2 temperatures and time slots with days, start, end, and band (eco/comfort/comfort2).

error.invalid_schedule: Invalid schedule format. Required keys: eco, comfort, comfort2, slots.
error.invalid_temperature: Temperature values must be between 10.0 and 40.0.
error.invalid_time: Time values must be in HH:MM format with start before end.
error.invalid_day: Day names must be: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.
error.overlapping_slots: Time slots overlap on the same day.
error.schedule_send_failed: Failed to send schedule to module.
